title: Resolved relative comparison of short exact rows before cone passage
statement: Assume derived module categories on every scheme [def-pc-derived-category]. Let f:X to S, f-prime:X-prime to S-prime, g:S-prime to S and g-prime:X-prime to X form a cartesian square. Fix K in D(O_X), K-prime in D(O_X-prime), phi:L(g-prime)* K to K-prime [def-pc-derived-pullback], and opens U,V covering X. Use the pinned global arrow a and local arrows b(W) [def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. Let G be underived module direct image along g, F its cochain functor and eta the right-derived localization comparison [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data]. There exist short complexes P on S and P-prime on S-prime, both short exact, and an actual short-complex morphism m:P to P-prime.map F. There are six vertex isomorphisms identifying Lg* Q(P.X1), Lg* Q(P.X2), Lg* Q(P.X3) with a.left, b(U).left direct-sum b(V).left and b(U intersection V).left, and Q(P-prime.X1), Q(P-prime.X2), Q(P-prime.X3) with the corresponding right vertices. The adjoint mates of Q(m.tau1) eta, Q(m.tau2) eta and Q(m.tau3) eta, after these vertex comparisons, are a.hom, biprod.map b(U).hom b(V).hom and b(U intersection V).hom, respectively. No mapping-cone identification, cone map, tensor-pullback complex or triangle assertion is included.

source.place: Tags 08BV, 08HZ, 08FE and 08HY; resolved relative row comparison before cone passage. Tag 0D5T and lem-pc-ringed-space-direct-image-kinjective-acyclic justify the unbounded direct-image computations. The explicit homotopy-pullback differential below is the agent-written elementary rectification.

proof.text: Choose injective-term K-injective I,J representing K,K-prime. Resolve g-prime_* J by L with quasi-isomorphism rho and represent the transposed coefficient arrow by r:I to L. Form S=f_* MV(I), R=f_* MV(L), P-prime=f-prime_* MV(J) on the inverse-image cover, and T=G(P-prime). Sheaf gluing and injective flasqueness prove these rows exact on sections, including T. Sectionwise comparisons give strict row maps u:S to R and v:T to R. Every v component is a quasi-isomorphism: restriction and open direct image preserve K-injectivity; apply isIso_moduleDirectImage_unit_on_kInjective to these K-injective complexes on X-prime and the subsequent direct images. Naturality of the right-derived units identifies Q(v) with the derived images of rho. This uses unbounded direct-image acyclicity, never a general assertion about termwise flasque complexes.

Take the row homotopy pullback P of u and v. In degree n at each vertex set P_i^n=S_i^n direct-sum T_i^n direct-sum R_i^(n-1), with differential (s,t,z) maps to (ds,dt,-dz+u(s)-v(t)), and the summandwise horizontal maps. This is a short exact row because S,T,R are exact. Projection p:P to S is a degreewise split epimorphism whose kernel at vertex i is Cone(v_i)[-1], up to sign. Since v_i is a quasi-isomorphism, its cone is acyclic and p_i is a quasi-isomorphism. Projection m:P to T is a strict row map and projection to z supplies the row homotopy u p homotopic to v m. Therefore Q(m_i)=Q(v_i)^(-1) Q(u_i) Q(p_i), simultaneously at all three vertices. This is an explicit replacement of the actual row roof and retains its quotient component. No cone-to-quotient identification is used.

Compose source vertex comparisons with Lg* and target comparisons with the exact-open and pinned direct-image composition comparisons. Apply the right-derived unit eta and take the pinned adjunction mates. Expand base change as the mate of the pulled-back counit. Pasting the composite counit formula gives the global equation. Naturality of open units and the underived open counit square give the two local equations; biproduct projection extensionality gives the middle equation. The same counit computation on the retained quotient gives the overlap equation. For an empty open the relevant terms are zero, for repeated opens the restriction rows split, and zero coefficients and zero phi give zero rows and row maps.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08BV, 08HZ, 08FE, 08HY and 0D5T; resolved rows and unbounded direct-image acyclicity. from.place: Resolved relative short exact row comparison, before the cone-to-quotient passage in lem-pc-relative-mv-direct-image-homotopy-comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem relativeMV_direct_image_rows
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (U V : X.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) :
    let G := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage g.toLRSHom.toShHom
    let F := G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let η := schemeMVDirectImageLocalization g
    let adj := relativeMVAdj g
    let a := relativeMVGlobalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    let b := relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    ∃ (P : ShortComplex (CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) ℤ))
      (P' : ShortComplex (CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) ℤ))
      (m : P ⟶ P'.map F)
      (e₁ : (derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₁) ≅ a.left)
      (e₂ : (derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₂) ≅
        (b U).left ⊞ (b V).left)
      (e₃ : (derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₃) ≅ (b (U ⊓ V)).left)
      (e₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₁ ≅ a.right)
      (e₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₂ ≅ (b U).right ⊞ (b V).right)
      (e₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₃ ≅ (b (U ⊓ V)).right),
      P.ShortExact ∧ P'.ShortExact ∧
      (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₁ ≫ η.app P'.X₁) ≫ e₁'.hom =
        e₁.hom ≫ a.hom ∧
      (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₂ ≫ η.app P'.X₂) ≫ e₂'.hom =
        e₂.hom ≫ biprod.map (b U).hom (b V).hom ∧
      (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₃ ≫ η.app P'.X₃) ≫ e₃'.hom =
        e₃.hom ≫ (b (U ⊓ V)).hom
